Kat Macdonald is a London-based sound and performance artist exploring collective practice and public space through technology, transmission and alternative pedagogies. She is the founder of the London Community Laptop Orchestra and a long time member of the Design And Performance Lab (DAP Lab). Her work has been shown internationally at festivals such as Creative Intelligence @ The Southbank Centre, Lumbung Radio Assembly, Intimidades Públicas (ICNOVA), The World Transformed, and more.

⚇ i miss the internet ( September 2026 ) ⚇

I presented the warm up piece from the London Community Laptop Orchestra at the Photographers Gallery as part of Error 417 Foundations “i miss the internet” event.


⚇ creative intelligence ( September 2026 ) ⚇

The London Community Laptop Orchestra got to perform at the Southbank Centre as part of Creative Intelligence. Thanks so Peckham Digital for progamming us!


⚇ digital micro publics ( September 2026 ) ⚇

I led a lecture / workshop at Termite begining research into the topic of “what is a digital micro public?”
